testcase.name: Scenario: Collapse and expands the origin branch: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:5:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Collapse and expands the origin branch ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And an active part in the MCAD Software contains a visible solid and has a visible model browser ✔ And the Origin branch is expanded ✔ Then the branch shows three origin planes, three origin axes and a center point ✔ When the user clicks the Origin branch expansion control ✔ Then the origin children are hidden ✔ And the Origin branch remains visible ✔ And the solid remains visible in the viewport ✔ When the user clicks the Origin branch expansion control again ✔ Then the origin planes, axes and center point are visible again ✔ And the solid remains in the same apparent view
